decided: Every tripwire is built as a sensor behind one shared contract, and further sensors can be added: the five signals in the tripwires stage are the first built-in ones, a project can add its own (such as a linter or a code-structure check) by naming a command whose output is one reading, and a review can report a judgement that orbit turns into a reading.
alternatives: build the five signals as five separate checks, each with its own wiring
why: The user wants other checks to plug in later without changing how stops are raised, and one contract means every sensor reaches the same stop record, the same chain halt and the same brief section.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course; when it fires, orbit writes a stop record of the tripwire kind.
